common.title: Major Cyber Incident
common.line: A large, largely automated attack lands.

common.title: Knowledge Work Is Boosted, Not Replaced
common.line: The evidence arrives from ordinary offices rather than from laboratories: measured productivity gains in law, accountancy, administration, journalism and consulting, largest among the least experienced, and no matching fall in employment.

notable.title: Taiwan Blockade
notable.line: A quarantine or blockade halts advanced semiconductor exports.

notable.title: Frontier Access Denied
notable.line: The Union is cut off from the leading model at short notice, wholly or by nationality of user.

notable.title: Infrastructure sabotage wave
notable.line: Coordinated physical sabotage against data-centre construction and grid segmentation sites spreads across several member states, moving from protest to sustained arson and equipment damage that delays hardening work.

notable.title: Anti ai electoral surge
notable.line: Anti-AI parties coordinate cross-border municipal bans on new data-centre construction and AI use in schools and hiring, winning regional votes and forcing permit freezes beyond the existing siting backlash.
